description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Hide read receipts

description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Hide Reels badge

description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Hide stories and notes

description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Hide typing indicator

description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Install beside Meta apps

description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Keep a message log

description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Keep emoji search on emoji

description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. Encrypted chats aren't supported, and group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Keep unsent messages

description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Light mode stays the same. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Material You theme

description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, so you can open these settings from inside Messenger. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Open settings from menu

description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Open web links externally

description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Restore old emoji drawer

description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Restore screens on re-signed builds

description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Save any story

description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo as the original image instead of Messenger's recompressed copy, so it stays sharper. Photos over 20 MB are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Send photos at original quality

description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Send videos without re-encoding

description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Slide chats in and out

description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Spoof package version

options.description: A whole number up to 2147483647, no lower than the Messenger you're patching. Pick one higher than Messenger's version in the Play Store, or it will keep offering updates. The default is the highest Android allows.
options.title: Version number

description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Stop ad attribution uploads

description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Stop analytics uploads

description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app (org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg) that signs in to your Google account through microG: saved places and lists, Timeline, location sharing, contributions and push messages. Remove sign-in prompts, Trim account menu and Remove permissions are left out of this build, Offline saved places keeps only its Local saved screen, which copies your account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account), and its icon carries microG's C. Needs microG: MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore. Not for root (mount) installs.
name: Add microG support

description: Allows Google Maps, Android Auto, and third-party media controllers to connect to YouTube Music.
name: Allow external media browser connections

dependencies: Allow Morphe YouTube Music package visibility
description: Enables YouTube Music and modded media apps as the navigation mini player.
name: Allow Morphe YouTube Music mini player

options.description: Package name of your modded YouTube Music app.
options.title: YouTube Music package name

description: Adds package queries and permission to AndroidManifest.xml for full media apps visibility.
name: Allow Morphe YouTube Music package visibility

description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.
name: Black theme

description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing.
name: Bypass Play Services checks

description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name and adds MicroG spoofing.
name: Change package name

options.description: The package name to install under.
options.title: Package name

description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.
name: Customization screen

description: Elevates the right-side navigation buttons (Search, Sound, Report, Media) above the media player and bottom panel during turn-by-turn navigation in portrait mode.
name: Elevate right navigation buttons

options.description: Height in dp to elevate the right navigation buttons above the media player.
options.title: Elevation (dp)

description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG's (microg Services) or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is never used, so location keeps working without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.
name: Location provider toggle

options.description: The location source Maps starts with. On: the fused provider -- Google Play services', or microG's in microG Maps -- whenever it is installed and enabled, Android's own providers otherwise. Off: Android's own providers. Can be changed later on the Customization screen.
options.title: Default to Play services location

description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.
name: Power saving mode

description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG support, whose account features need them.
name: Remove permissions

description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services.
name: Remove telemetry

description: Lets a re-signed Maps load tiles, search and routing, by sending Google's own package and certificate.
name: Restore map data

description: Adds +, − and reset tiles during turn-by-turn that change the navigation zoom while the camera keeps following the car.
name: Zoom controls in navigation

description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Stop inbox and ad link logging

description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages

description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Unlock app icons

description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Use system emoji

description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Use the phone's camera app

description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: Use your own font

description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
name: View stories anonymously

description: Adds quality defaults, the advanced quality menu, and a quality player button.
name: Video quality

description: Adds a button that opens the current video's quality picker.
name: Video quality player button

description: Replaces native Oculus face/eye permission checks with the Android XR permission names used by the legacy Galaxy XR build.
name: Android XR native permission names

description: Recommended. Adds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW to the manifest so GalaxyXRPermissionActivity can request overlay permission at startup.
name: Appear on top

description: Renames the app package so it can be installed alongside the original Steam Link. Default appends '.gxr'. Changing the package name may break features that rely on the original identity.
name: Change package name

options.description: Accepts either a full Java package name (for example, com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr) or a display suffix (for example, Galaxy XR). Suffix input appends to app name and generates a package suffix automatically.
options.title: Package name

description: Derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history and can reduce VRLink's stock four controller pose sends per display frame.
name: Controller velocity fix

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+32 (int64 ns = value×1e6). Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.
options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so QSVLClient::OnTopOfFrame: selects four, two, or one evenly phased controller pose sends per display frame. Actual send Hz equals display Hz multiplied by 4, 2, or 1. Stock preserves Valve behavior.
options.title: Controller pose-send cadence

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+48 (float32 EMA weight). 0 = no smoothing, minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
options.title: Derived velocity smoothing

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+40 (float32 m/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived linear speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.
options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)

description: Overrides the HMD manufacturer/model identity reported to SteamVR (hmd_config.json only; controller identity is unaffected). 'samsung-default' leaves the file untouched.
name: Device identity

options.description: assets/config/hmd_config.json: overwrites sSerialNumber, sManufacturerName, sModelNumber, sControllerType, sDeviceType, sInputProfilePath, requestedExtensions.
options.title: HMD identity

description: Bypasses the two legacy-tested capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init for Steam Link build 5002244.
name: Force HMD initialization gates

description: Bypasses the legacy-tested permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby for Steam Link build 5002244.
name: Force lobby permission-state gate

description: Bypasses the three legacy-tested XR feature/permission gates in XrSceneStream::Init for Steam Link build 5002244.
name: Force stream XR gates

description: Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest.
name: GXR face bridge

description: Adds a configurable offset to the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes all six exported HMD velocity fields. Does not affect controller paths.
name: HMD-only pose fix

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so: AArch64 MOVZ/MOVK at PLT cave adds value×1e6 ns to X2 in QSVLDeviceHmd::GetPose. Tested default: 60 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.
options.title: Pose offset (ms)

description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link 5002244.
name: OLED color calibration

options.description: Selects the gamma and saturation pair used in the 1087-byte video shader.
options.title: Calibration profile

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
options.title: Gamma

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.
options.title: Saturation

options.description: Safe control retains GL_SRGB8_ALPHA8. Experimental mode requests linear GL_RGB10_A2 and applies an explicit sRGB EOTF. Galaxy XR runtime support is unverified.
options.title: Video output precision

description: Recommended. Opens Android's per-app Battery usage page at startup so Unrestricted can be selected for XR streaming.
name: Unrestricted battery usage

description: Enables or disables VRLink video dithering, including the highp sRGB8 fallback and experimental RGB10_A2 shader variants.
name: Video dither

options.description: Stock shader toggles its dormant line; legacy calibrated shader toggles its scale; highp output shaders toggle DITHER_ENABLE while retaining the correct .00392 or .00073 scale.
options.title: Enable dither

description: Installs the Galaxy XR runtime bridge resources and extension DEX foundation used by other XR patches.
name: XR Core Runtime

description: Installs baseline Galaxy XR HMD/controller/default config payloads and dashboard bootstrap assets.
name: XR Device Config Baseline

description: Installs ui_config.json mappings for XR pointer/button routing in launcher UI flows.

description: Installs GalaxyXRPermissionActivity as launcher and configures Steam Link/VRLink activity XR startup wiring.

description: Adds Android XR/OpenXR permissions, features, runtime queries, and app-level XR properties.
name: XR Manifest Capability Pack

description: Experimental window/permission A/B probe. Turn off Appear on top and do not combine with older resolution test APK modifications.
name: XR resolution permission experiment

options.description: Select exactly one complete test state. Only Granted overlay control requests Appear on top.
options.title: Experiment mode

name: All-In-One
